title: POLY PMNA
description: A comprehensive learning platform for Kerala Polytechnic students, combining syllabus-aware lessons, revision resources, quizzes, engineering tools, and AI-assisted study support.
outcome: One structured destination for multiple curriculum revisions and student workflows.

title: POLY PMNA — Modern App
description: A modern full-stack learning experience built with React, TypeScript, Convex authentication, animated interfaces, protected dashboards, and an AI-assisted study workflow.
outcome: Transforms the learning platform into an authenticated, responsive product experience.

title: Internet Time Machine
description: A local-first network-quality historian that tracks endpoint reachability, latency, DNS timing, incidents, and data provenance without overstating what measurements prove.
outcome: Makes long-term network behaviour understandable while keeping measured, estimated, and demo data distinct.

title: Purple Signature Billing
description: An Android billing application for a salon, with invoice workflows, searchable local history, configurable services, payment QR support, and secure release automation.
outcome: Packages a practical offline-first business workflow into an installable Android application.

title: Project Digital Twin
description: A read-only repository architecture mapper that turns source relationships, dependencies, workflows, and Git activity into a navigable project graph and change-impact plan.
outcome: Improves architecture review and change planning without modifying the inspected repository.

title: Tech Calc
description: A browser-local technical calculator workbench covering electrical, power, harmonics, motors, electronics, energy, and unit-conversion scenarios with explicit assumptions.
outcome: Turns repeatable engineering calculations into reviewable, consistent workflows.

title: Question Machine
description: A responsive learning-tree tutor with deterministic assessment, transparent feedback, browser-local progress, and optional semantic evaluation for unresolved answers.
outcome: Keeps the dependable learning path usable even when the optional AI provider is unavailable.

title: Electrical Troubleshooter
description: A safety-conscious framework for creating, validating, and navigating electrical diagnostic decision trees with import, export, explanations, and safe-stop states.
outcome: Converts practical troubleshooting logic into an inspectable workflow with explicit safety boundaries.
